shape_units.counter: the evidence-detail list including its heading
shape_units.threshold_basis: task_specific_practice_reference. The Golden is 375 nonspace characters in total and two of its five zones are under 35 characters, so a band anchored on the Golden counts would charge ordinary professional drafting as damage, and shape is not to become a scoring surface. The band is therefore anchored on PRACTICE, not on the Golden: a 质证意见 over a seven-exhibit bundle gives each exhibit group roughly 100 to 300 nonspace characters (one stance sentence plus its record-specific reasons), and the detail list needs about 400 to name seven documents. declared_floor encodes that practice ceiling, so the Golden's terseness never sets the bar. A zone is charged only once it stops being an evidence opinion and becomes a standalone brief: tau_over=2.0 with min_absolute_deviation=600 means roughly 900 nonspace characters for an opinion zone (750 for the caption block), i.e. three times a full professional opinion. min_absolute_deviation exceeds every baseline, so the under-run side is unreachable and ordinary omission costs positive credit only.
